output_json.diff_review: Product change is confined to ExternalResourceHandler.getResource(): `path = UriPath.canonical(path.replace('\\','/'))` plus a `if (path == null) return null;` guard. Root cause verified in source: UriPath.canonical() only treats '/' as a separator (leaving '/..\\secret.txt' unchanged), while ExternalResource->StringUtils.cleanPath() converts '\\'->'/' and collapses '..', escaping the base dir. Normalizing '\\'->'/' before canonical() turns the attack into '/../secret.txt', which canonical() rejects (returns null on '..' above root). The null guard is required because canonical() can now legitimately return null. Change is a no-op for legitimate forward-slash paths. Does not remove functionality or add unrelated behavior. The pov.diff only adds the self-contained POV harness and compiled artifacts under .security-pipeline/pov/; no product code or existing tests were modified by the POV. The only test change is an added regression test (testGetResource_whenPathUsesBackslashTraversal_thenReturnNull) asserting getResource("/..\\secret.txt") returns null.
issues: Sibling handlers (e.g. ClassPathResourceHandler) sharing similar UriPath usage were not modified; noted by patcher as out of scope for this alert, so no meaningful residual risk for the flagged ExternalResourceHandler path.
output_json.pov_result: Reran POV on patched code: "[POV] getResource() returned null -> traversal blocked. Not vulnerable." EXIT=1. Orchestrator log confirms unpatched code exits 0 (VULNERABLE, served /tmp/.../secret.txt with TOP-SECRET content). Vulnerability no longer reproduces after patch.
output_json.regression_result: Reran `mvn -B -Dtest=ExternalResourceHandlerTest,UriPathTest test`: BUILD SUCCESS, Tests run: 12, Failures: 0, Errors: 0. ExternalResourceHandlerTest now has 7 tests (up from 6 at HEAD), confirming the new backslash-traversal regression test ran and passed alongside existing coverage; UriPathTest (5) passes.
output_json.summary: The patch fixes the CWE-022 path traversal in ExternalResourceHandler.getResource() by normalizing backslashes to forward slashes before UriPath.canonical() and rejecting paths that canonicalize above root (null return). The fix is minimal and appropriate, the original POV no longer reproduces (exit 0 -> exit 1), and regression tests pass.
